title: Laligurash — handcrafted candles from Nepal
headline: Poured in Lalitpur, by women who work from home.
tagline: Soy candles in terracotta, printed glass and sculpted wax. Four scents, one soy wax, four hours or more of flame.
section1_text: Laligurash is Nepal's national flower. The candles are made at kitchen tables in Imadol by women who set their own hours, in clay from valley potters, with petals shaped one at a time.
